high_level_description: The image shows a lively scene of a group of people dancing together outdoors at night. The setting appears to be an open area with some trees and a building in the background, illuminated by artificial lighting that creates a festive atmosphere. The group consists of several individuals, both men and women, dressed in casual attire suitable for a social gathering or celebration. One man stands out prominently in the center wearing a yellow turban, a black vest over a yellow shirt, and dark pants. He is actively dancing and appears to be leading the group.
